condition_schema.primary: exactly one of ABSENCE, TRACE, CONSUMPTION, CO-PRESENCE, SOLITARY PRESENCE, CROSSING, ATTENTION, CONTRADICTION, ARRANGEMENT, FOUND, OCCURRENCE / WITNESS, RETURN, UNKNOWN
condition_schema.subject: separate metadata; never determines Condition

note: Condition is assigned first from the Presence-world relationship. Preservation class is assigned second. Manual decisions override automated suggestions.
